regime.skew: mildly put-rich, but flattening (+0.78 vs +1.98 five sessions ago)
regime.label: Dealer long-gamma cage 1070-1100 at series-low IV, anchored on 1070 max pain
evidence: Net GEX +10,779 index-point units is the highest of the whole U26 series and 54x the +199 printed on 2026-09-03; the ATM band 1070-1100 alone contributes +11,808, so dealers are long gamma exactly where price sits.
1090 gamma flip sits 8.1 points above spot 1081.9 - almost exactly one 1-sigma day (8.48) - and has migrated down 50 points from 1140 on 2026-09-03, tightening the cage rather than releasing it.
12.44% ATM IV is the lowest print in the series' 36-session history (14.09% on 2026-09-03), compressing the 1-sigma day to 8.48 points from 9.39.

2.29 P/C OI ratio is a series record on +2,577 put OI added in 5 sessions against -170 call OI, but with IV falling and 25-delta skew flattening to +0.78 this is systematic hedging, not a panic protection bid.

S50U26.today_summary: 1081.9 closed 1.6 points lower and 11.9 points (1.4 sigma) above 1070 max pain, which has now been parked at 1070 for four straight sessions. 2,763 call OI at 1100 on 344 lots of volume is the live near-money ceiling; 2,164 put OI at 1050 on 502 lots - today's heaviest single-strike print - is the live floor. The 16,321-contract 910 put wall is structural residue, not active: 10 lots traded, gamma is zero and its 30.8% IV is a stale quote, so it carries no hedging force. Strike-level net GEX flips sign at 1070 (+18) and turns firmly positive at 1080/+3,154 and 1100/+4,556, making 1070 the trapdoor rather than the support.
what_changed: Gamma flip fell 50 points, 1140 on 2026-09-03 to 1090 today, while net GEX rose from +199 to +10,779 - dealers went from flat to decisively long gamma in five sessions.
ATM IV compressed 1.65 vol points, 14.09% to 12.44%, dragging the 1-sigma day from 9.39 to 8.48 points.
1050 put OI built +334 to 2,164 and 1000 put OI built +746, while 1030-1070 calls shed 450 contracts - the book rolled its protection down and let upside decay.
25-delta skew flattened from +1.98 to +0.78 even as put OI hit a record 44,289, confirming hedge accumulation without a volatility bid.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: The 23.6-point rally from 1058.3 on 2026-09-03 to 1081.9 was absorbed, not chased: max pain drifted only 1060 to 1070 and the 1100 call wall never moved, so dealers financed the move by getting longer gamma the whole way up. That is the classic long-gamma dampener - every 8-point excursion is met with hedging in the opposite direction, which is why realised range has narrowed alongside the 1.65-point IV compression. The put book grew to a record 44,289 contracts but 25-delta skew flattened to +0.78, so the flow is calendar-driven collar and covered-call mechanics rather than fear; heavy put OI here is a burden map showing where hedges are parked, not a bearish vote. The active cage is 1070 to 1100: 1070 is where strike-level net GEX crosses zero and 13 sessions remain to the 2026-09-29 expiry, so a sustained break below flips dealers short gamma into a region with only 1,285-2,164 puts per strike to slow it. Against that, 1090 to 1100 needs to absorb 4,863 combined call OI on rising volume, and no session in the last five has closed above 1083.3.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1030P / 1050P x 1100C / 1120C
strategies.rationale: Sells the two live walls - 2,164 put OI at 1050 and 2,763 call OI at 1100 - inside a +10,779 net-GEX cage where dealer hedging mechanically fades 8.48-point excursions.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point wing width minus roughly 5.95 points of net credit at mid = about 14.05 points per side.
strategies.invalidation: A close beyond 1100 (call wall) or 1050 (near put wall); either breach puts price outside the strikes the cage is built on.

strategies.name: Bull call spread 1080 / 1100
strategies.rationale: Expresses the 1070-to-1100 drift the long-gamma cage has produced for five sessions, buying 12.67% IV at the series low and capping exactly at the 2,763-contract call wall where the drift has repeatedly stalled.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = about 8.5 points of net debit at mid; max value 20 points at or above 1100.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1070, the strike-level GEX sign flip and current max pain.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1060 / 1040
strategies.rationale: Buys the 25-delta/10-delta band (1060/1040) at a flattened +0.78 skew and 12.44% ATM IV, covering the one path the cage does not dampen: below 1070 net GEX turns negative and dealer hedging starts amplifying the move.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = about 2.5 points of net debit at mid; max value 20 points at or below 1040.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1090, the gamma flip, which restores the long-gamma dampener and removes the amplification the structure is built for.

S50U26.prediction: Base case is a 1070-1100 range while dealers hold +10,779 net GEX, with 1081.9 mean-reverting toward the 1070 anchor on any 8.48-point excursion and upside progress capped near the 2,763-contract 1100 wall. The bias turns from range to trend on a daily close below 1070, where strike-level GEX goes negative and the next meaningful put OI is 1,285 at 1040. Conversely a close above 1090 with call OI above 1100 being bought rather than sold would mark the cage failing upward.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no execution is being recommended. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no physical delivery to force stock-side hedging into strikes; pinning toward 1070 max pain is a statistical tendency and is structurally weaker here than for physically-settled single stocks. Defined-risk does not mean low-risk: the short-vol condor above carries a real 14.05-point max loss per side and negative skew - many small gains, occasional large ones. The 16,321-contract 910 put wall fails the Vol2Vol filter (10 lots, zero gamma, 30.8% stale IV) and should not be read as support. All figures derive from the 2026-09-10T02:08+07:00 scrape of a 25-row chain; 13 trading sessions remain to the 2026-09-29 last trading date.
